text: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle involves more than just avoiding illness; it is about feeling your best every day. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, provides the fuel your body needs. Alongside good nutrition, regular exercise, even a brisk 30-minute walk, strengthens your heart and boosts your mood. Equally important is getting enough sleep, as it allows your body to repair and your mind to recharge. However, true health also includes mental well-being. Managing stress through mindfulness or hobbies, and ensuring a healthy work-life balance by setting boundaries, are essential. When you care for both your body and mind, you create a foundation for lasting energy and happiness.
